verified_true: Lemma سَلام (salām) noun census = 42 tokens (root سلم, lemma filter). Matches the proposal's stated 42.
First token of lemma سَلام in mushaf order = 4:94 (ٱلسَّلَٰمَ, ACC).
Last token of lemma سَلام in mushaf order = 97:5 (سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ).

4:94 is combat/expedition context (إِذَا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ) with the worldly-goods motive (تَبْتَغُونَ عَرَضَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا) — the proposal's 'want his goods' framing is accurate.

Exhibit GRAPH-9 internal claims independently re-derived and TRUE: root زلزل = 6 tokens / 4 verses (2:214, 22:1, 33:11, 99:1); 3 verb tokens ALL PERF|PASS (2:214 3MP, 33:11 3MP, 99:1 3FS); believers shaken in 2:214 & 33:11, earth in 99:1; nouns at 22:1/33:11/99:1.
broken_claims: TITLE + THESIS 'The First "Peace" in the Quran ... first appears as a greeting ... a peace a person can accept or reject' — BROKEN. Two earlier 'peace' occurrences precede 4:94 in mushaf order: (a) 2:208 ٱلسِّلْمِ (silm = peace/reconciliation, 'enter into peace wholly'); (b) 4:90 and 4:91 ٱلسَّلَمَ (salam, lemma سَلَم), BOTH in the near-identical construction 'أَلْقَوْا۟/يُلْقُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلسَّلَمَ' = 'offered you peace' — a refusable peace-offer tied to a restraint ruling ('فَمَا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ سَبِيلًا'). The exact 'refusable peace offered to you + combat-restraint' motif the proposal assigns to 4:94 debuts 3-4 verses EARLIER at 4:90-91. The 'first' survives only under an undisclosed vowel-level lemma split (سَلام vs سَلَم vs سِلْم) that the reader-facing word 'peace' does not honor.

EXHIBIT MISMATCH — the proposal's sole cited exhibit, GRAPH-9, is about the earthquake verb زلزل and has ZERO connection to salām/peace. The salam thesis therefore ships with no supporting exhibit; the first/last/42 salām facts (verified here) are not encoded anywhere in the attached evidence.
required_corrections: 1) LOAD-BEARING: 'first peace' as worded is refuted by 2:208 (silm) and especially 4:90-91 (salam, سَلَم) which use the identical 'alqaw/yulqoo ilaykum as-salam = offered you peace' phrasing four and three verses before 4:94, also carrying a fight-restraint ruling. To salvage, the claim MUST be re-scoped from 'the first peace' to 'the first occurrence of the specific noun salām (سَلام) — the word of the greeting, the Divine Name As-Salām (59:23), and Paradise's greeting' AND must name and neutralize silm (2:208) and salam (4:90-91) up front, explaining the lexical distinction (Raghib distinguishes salām/soundness-greeting from silm/salm/making-peace). Without this the one-tweet skeptic rebuttal ('same phrase alqaw ilaykum as-salam appears in 4:90 four verses earlier — you split a vowel') lands and the piece reads as the exact cherry-pick the site claims to avoid. 2) Replace the wrong exhibit: GRAPH-9 (earthquakes) does not belong; attach a salām first/last/42 exhibit. 3) 97:5 'nothing can interrupt' overstates — 'حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ' BOUNDS the peace to the night (it concludes at dawn); reframe to 'uninterrupted THROUGH the night to its term at dawn,' not eternal/uninterruptable. 4) Keep all language as position 'in the Book / on the page' (mushaf order); do NOT slip into 'first/last revealed' — chronologically 4:94 is Medinan (late) and Sura 97 early Meccan, which reverses the arc. 5) 4:94 'peace you can accept or reject' is in tension with the verse's actual force (a PROHIBITION on refusing) — proposal already flags this; keep it explicit. 6) Note the 4:94 qira'at: Hafs reads ٱلسَّلَٰمَ (salām) but Ibn Kathir/Hamza/Khalaf read ٱلسَّلَمَ (salam) — the variant itself blurs the salām/salam boundary and strengthens the 'why salām not salam' objection; address it. 7) Honor the al-Qadr Meccan/Medinan classification dispute (proposal flags this).
